amendment.reason: The selected aggregate exchange feed refreshes pregame exchange prices on approximately a 20-second cadence. A sustained 10-poll feasibility audit observed source update intervals around 21 seconds across Betfair, Matchbook and Smarkets. The change is based only on source feasibility and was made before H2-v2 outcomes, PnL or signal-threshold analysis.

explicit_non_decisions: No trading edge threshold is selected in M1.
No optimal polling cadence for calibration is selected in M1.
No maker versus taker decision is revised in M1.
RN1 is not added to the H2-v2 primary model.
No H2-v2 PnL is calculated in M1.

m1_collection.purpose: Validate synchronized sharp and Polymarket CLOB research data quality only.
m1_collection.reason_for_30s_m1_cadence: M1 is an engineering/data-quality test. Thirty seconds provides repeated observations while conserving API credits. This cadence does not freeze the later calibration signal evaluation cadence.

joint: sharp and PM observations can be aligned by local capture time
no signal or PnL logic is required for M1
sharp: at least two valid fresh exchange families on >=80% of eligible snapshots

sharp_source.consensus: median of all valid fresh family probabilities
sharp_source.family_probability: probability-space midpoint of best back and best lay
valid_family_requirements: bookmaker is one of the three frozen exchange families
exactly two common team outcomes exist
back and lay prices are positive valid decimal odds
source age is between 0 and 25 seconds inclusive
